newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Biota shares boosted on drug hopes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Biota shares boosted on drug hopes.

text.p: Shares in biotechnology company Biota Holdings Ltd soared to a three month high of A$3.85 on Monday on high hopes for its anti-influenza drug, GG167, brokers said.

The rise follows the announcement on January 28 that the company had chosen United States-based Biostar Inc to proceed with full-scale development of a point-of-care diagnostic test for all strains of influenza and was aided by favourable coverage of the company in U.S. and local media reports.

In its January 31 edition, The New York Times highlighted Gilead Sciences' trials of a drug similar to Biota's treatment, but warned that the Australian firm was likely to beat Gilead's product to the market.
However, while the U.S. reports could not be discounted, local recent media coverage has also been positive and this was likely to have been the major driver, broker said.
"They have also featured in articles in the Sunday papers in Australia yesterday and that would probably had more of an impact," said a Brisbane-based dealer.
By 12.30 p.m. (0130 GMT), Biota shares were 19 cents higher at A$3.70 on turnover of 263,472 shares.
